g.text: Every way okl runs: the moment it fires, what starts it, the command it runs,
and whether it can stop you. Each reads the store, or, in CI, the snapshot of it.
in a session with your agent
when the work leaves your machine
clone, or Postgres, or a service
read by every check above; written by okl record,
update, retire and verify, from the CLI or over MCP
last check, committed with the code
okl verify and okl export --drift write it
can stop you: the prompt, the stop, the push or the build
hooks: other agents call okl_check over MCP
works whatever agent wrote the code
